alt: 孩子指著自己普通的花朵畫昂首自誇，心裡卻把自己想成眾人崇拜、獎盃環繞的大畫家，旁邊同學仍安靜認真作畫。
scene_prompt: 自命不凡 means thinking oneself exceptionally talented and important without grounds. Modern children's painting club. A child stands beside their very ordinary amateur flower painting, proudly puffing chest and pointing a thumb toward themself, with a self-important satisfied expression. A soft graphite thought bubble above this child shows their OWN imagined future as a celebrated artist surrounded by huge golden award cups and a crowd admiring their painting, clearly fantasy rather than real awards. In the real room the child's actual picture is basic and clumsy, while two classmates quietly make thoughtful more accomplished drawings without paying attention to the boastful child's claims. Keep the central contrast between inflated self-image and modest real ability, not simply ambitious dreams: pose smug and self-congratulatory, not hardworking or humbly hopeful. No crowns in real scene, no readable text, titles, labels, signatures or numbers. Three actual children, main child's fantasy figure visually distinct within bubble, all anatomically coherent, natural hands gripping pencils, stable desks. Pencil watercolor ivory paper.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. NO text, letters, numerals, captions, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Clear visual storytelling for elementary school readers and readable at mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass green, pale sky blue, warm earthy browns, generous ivory breathing room. No flat digital blocks, glossy rendering, 3D or imitation of a named artist.
